senses.gloss: m. (בלס; cmp. ὕαλος, ὕελος) a shapeless mass, a glass-ball.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 2:13">Num. R. s. 2</cite> <he>ומוציאו בולים</he> (v. <cite ref="B00253"><he>בּוּל</he> II</cite>, some ed. <cite ref="B00268"><he>בוליס</he></cite>).

R. s. 12</cite> <he>מוצק כלים</he> read: <he>נוסך ב׳</he>, v. Ar.) casts a lense; v. <cite ref="A02257"><he>אֲנַנְקֵי</he></cite>.—Pesik.
